verses.english: “Mendicants, these ten things exist because of the body.

verses.pali: Sītaṁ, uṇhaṁ, jighacchā, pipāsā, uccāro, passāvo, kāyasaṁvaro, vacīsaṁvaro, ājīvasaṁvaro, ponobhaviko bhavasaṅkhāro—
verses.english: Cold, heat, hunger, thirst, feces, urine, restraint of body, speech, and livelihood, and the will to live that leads to future lives.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā sarīraṭṭhā”ti.
verses.english: These ten things exist because of the body.”
